title: Landing Gear Bay Wiring — Chafe and Bonding Inspection of the Centre Fuselage Harnesses

ata.title: Electrical Wiring — Landing Gear Bay Wiring

abstract: Chafe and bonding inspection of the landing gear bay harnesses, covering the support intervals, the bonding lead resistance and the drip loop arrangement at the bay ceiling penetrations.

sections.purpose: This task gives the chafe and bonding inspection of the landing gear bay harnesses, including the support interval check, the bonding lead resistance measurement and the drip loop arrangement at the bay ceiling penetrations.
sections.job_setup_note: The landing gear must be on ground locks and the gear doors secured open before anyone enters the bay. The bonding measurement is taken with the aircraft unpowered and with the meter leads on the specified points; a reading taken to painted structure is meaningless. Water ingress at the ceiling penetrations is common on aircraft operating in heavy rain and the drip loop arrangement is the thing that keeps it out of the connector.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm the ground locks are fitted and that the gear doors are secured open. WARNING: DO NOT ENTER THE LANDING GEAR BAY WITHOUT THE GROUND LOCKS FITTED AND THE DOORS SECURED. 2. Remove electrical power and put the warning notice in position. 3. Examine each harness run for chafe, particularly where it crosses a structural edge or a hydraulic line. 4. Measure the support interval along each run and confirm it is within the figure given. 5. Examine every clamp for a missing or displaced cushion. CAUTION: A CLAMP WITH A DISPLACED CUSHION LOOKS SERVICEABLE FROM BELOW. CHECK EACH CLAMP FROM BOTH SIDES. 6. Examine the ceiling penetrations and confirm that each harness has a drip loop below the penetration. 7. Examine the connectors at the bay equipment for corrosion or water staining. 8. Measure the bonding lead resistance at each bonding point on the specified metal-to-metal contact areas, not on painted structure. 9. Record any reading above the limit. 10. Examine the circuit breaker assembly and the relay mounting for security. 11. Restore any protective treatment removed for the bonding measurement.
sections.close_out: Remove the warning notice and confirm nothing is left in the bay. Record every chafe finding with its station, the support intervals measured, the bonding readings and the drip loop condition. Report any bonding reading above the limit and any harness with chafe through the outer protection before the aircraft is released.

safety_precautions: Do not enter the bay without ground locks fitted and doors secured.
Remove electrical power before the bonding measurement.
Wear head protection in the bay.
